item.title: Sleeping Dragon Bookshelf Sitter, Fourth Wing Inspired Decor
item.description: A small sleeping dragon, curled up on the edge of a finished bookshelf. It's the kind of thing you set beside the books you love and then notice every time you reach for one. It sits just as well on a desk. We make each one to order here in Canada, printed in PLA plastic, and it makes an easy gift for the reader in your life who has already finished the series twice.
